name: Server-Manager-Portal
description: A self-hosted Plex server management portal with user onboarding, access expiry, analytics, status monitoring, and admin tools. After install, open the WebUI and sign in with your Plex admin account, then configure Plex token and SMTP in Settings. Optional Collexions: enable in Settings → Collexions (worker is bundled in this image — no second container). Data is stored under the Config Directory at collexions/. The container entrypoint automatically fixes appdata folder permissions on startup. Updates: this template uses the :latest tag (tracks main releases). To pin a specific version, change Repository to ghcr.io/jl94x4/server-manager-portal:1.4.0 (or v1.4.0).

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Persistent JSON data (users, settings, caches, logs). Container path: /app/config

paths.name: Backup Directory
paths.description: Rolling backup snapshots created from Settings. Container path: /app/backup

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the application as (default 99 on Unraid).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the application as (default 100 on Unraid).

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Required session signing secret (minimum 32 characters). Generate a secure random string to use here.

variables.name: Public Base URL
variables.description: Optional bootstrap HTTPS URL (no trailing slash). Prefer Settings → Portal UI → Public Base URL after first login. For subpath hosting include the path, e.g. https://plex.example.com/portal

variables.name: Base Path
variables.description: Optional URL prefix when hosted under a subpath (e.g. /portal). Leave empty for root hosting.

variables.name: Force Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to true only when the portal is served over HTTPS. Must be false for plain HTTP LAN access (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:2121).

variables.name: Allow Private Integration URLs
variables.description: Allow Sonarr/Radarr/Tautulli URLs on LAN/private IPs (recommended for homelab).

variables.name: Plex Remote Connection
variables.description: Use LAN/remote Plex URL instead of localhost when running in Docker. Auto-detected if unset; set true for Unraid.

variables.name: Setup Token
variables.description: Optional one-time token for remote first-time setup.

variables.name: Plex OAuth Client ID
variables.description: Optional fixed Plex OAuth client id (auto-generated on first run if empty).

variables.name: Config Data Directory
variables.description: Internal runtime data path (normally leave as /app/config).

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Application listen port inside the container.
